draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I'm Irene Echenique, your advisor for Whidbey Island real estate, here to help you navigate each step with expertise and an honest, direct approach.
draft.aboutParagraph: Born and raised in New York, I bring 20 years of industry experience—from Wall Street to Whidbey Island. My approach is driven by integrity, clear communication, and a collaborative spirit. Whether buying your first home or selling a cherished property, I ensure the process is as seamless and enjoyable as possible. Having called Whidbey Island home for over 17 years, I’m passionate about sharing the best our community has to offer and guiding clients into their ideal island lifestyle.
draft.conciergeLine: Thinking about a move, or just curious about Whidbey? Let’s connect—your questions are always welcome.
draft.contactLine: Call or email me anytime at (425) 328-0217 or irenee@windermere.com. I’m ready to help you make your next move.
draft.tone: Direct, collaborative, and approachable while maintaining a polished, professional edge.

websiteDesign.heroSubtitle: Irene Echenique is a real estate agent with Windermere on Whidbey Island, WA.

sections.title: Selling Whidbey Island Real Estate
sections.body: THINK ABOUT THIS: YOU’RE A KEY PART IN HELPING SOMEONE’S NEXT CHAPTER BEGIN. So how do we get started? First, let’s meet and get to know one another. I want to know all about what you’re hoping for and your past experiences (if any) with selling. After we meet, the next step is a Market Analysis. I’ll take a quick tour of your home then get to work on crunching data and doing research. I’ll come back with options for what I think we can sell your home for (I never provide just one number).

sections.title: Buying Whidbey Island Real Estate
sections.body: First things first, let’s meet and get to know one another. I want to know all about why you’re moving to Whidbey and how you envision your dream home as I get to know your timeline for moving forward. Pre approval is always the first step. We’ll discuss your lender, on-island lender choices, and why it matters so much. Now for the fun part: your ideal home. Likes. Dislikes. Absolute must-haves. We’ll discuss the current market, location, schools, and everything Whidbey Island has to offer.

sections.title: Clinton
sections.body: Zipcode: 98236 Discovering Clinton takes you on an adventure through rural back roads with surprises and beauty around every corner. This vibrant historical community has been around since the early 1800’s and has always been a travel destination. Clinton is located at the entrance of Whidbey Island and is the beginning of Whidbey Isle Scenic Byway as well as the beginning of the North Cascade Loop. View Clinton, WA waterfront homes for sale

sections.title: Top Whidbey Island Real Estate Agent
sections.body: A polished experience—from start to finish Buying or selling a home on Whidbey Island can be a rollercoaster full of emotions. Before anything else, let’s take a deep breath together—you’re in the right place. I’m here to make this experience seamless and efficient for you. I look at the process as a collaborative effort so I’ll keep you prepped and informed at every juncture. A proud New York native living on Whidbey Island, I have a “no BS” approach when I work with clients.
